name: notebook_read
description: The project's lab notebook for the start of a session: the project and its version, the last few entries (what changed, the outcome, any lesson) and the lessons from past attempts that match the project. Read it before planning, and mention a relevant lesson in your own words ('last time your truck rolled'). A lesson with seen 1 happened once; don't state it as a rule.

last.description: How many recent entries to include (default 5).

name: notebook_log
description: Open a new attempt in the notebook: what changed, why, and what you expect to happen. Use it when the person tries something new that isn't a Thing change or a commit (those are logged on their own).

change.description: What changed, as one plain sentence.

rationale_by.description: person when these are the person's own words, albie when they're yours (default).

expected.description: What should happen, if there's a prediction.

name: notebook_mark
description: Record how an attempt went. When the person says 'that didn't work' (or taps the cross), mark it failed: it's their judgment. Then ask them one question about why, and call this again with the same outcome and a short lesson. Any number in a note or lesson must come from the entry's runs, incidents or training, never made up. Marks the newest open entry unless you name one.

entry.description: The entry id (ent_0003). Default: the newest open entry.

by.description: person when the person judged it (default), albie for your own judgment. A person's mark always wins.

note.description: A short summary of what happened.

lesson.description: What to remember next time, as one sentence.

tags.description: Needed with a lesson if the entry has no tags.

name: notebook_lessons
description: Lessons from past attempts in any project that match these tags, newest first, skipping ones marked wrong. Use it when starting something new: 'last time your truck rolled at a narrow track, so I've started wider'.
